title: Understand the new interface: Overview, Review, and Strategy
summary: Learn the three main workspaces, their pages, and the global tools.
outcome: You will understand the Overview, Review, and Strategy workspaces and quickly find Market Data, Mentor, Achievements, and Settings.
before: You do not need to download market data or create a replay session first.

sections.title: 1. Three main workspaces
sections.body:
Overview summarizes your accounts and practice activity. Review contains chart replay, history, statistics, and account management. Strategy contains indicators, backtests, trading systems, and the strategy journal.

Decide which kind of task you are doing first, then open the matching workspace.

steps.title: Chart
steps.body: Advance historical market data, place simulated orders, draw on the chart, and use indicators.

steps.title: History
steps.body: Find trades, add reasons, tags, and notes, and open a chart preview.

steps.title: Statistics
steps.body: Review equity, P&L, drawdown, behavior distributions, and diagnostic findings.

steps.title: Accounts
steps.body: Manage replay sessions, backtest results, and live accounts.

sections.title: 3. Four pages in Strategy
sections.body: Indicators contains built-in and custom indicators. Backtest validates strategy expressions. Systems manages entry, risk, exit, and no-trade rules. Journal records strategy iterations.

sections.title: 4. Global tools
sections.body: The global tools provide access to Mentor, theme settings, Market Data, Achievements, and Settings. Some tools may move into the sidebar in a narrower layout, but their functions do not change.

callout.title: Check the window width if a tool seems to be missing
callout.body: On a narrow window, text labels may collapse into icons or move into the sidebar. Hover over an icon to see its name.

success: You can open Chart, History, Statistics, and Accounts from Review.
You can open Indicators, Backtest, Systems, and Journal from Strategy.
You can find Market Data and Settings in the global tools or sidebar.

faq.q: Why are my buttons in slightly different positions?
faq.a: TradeReplay adapts its navigation to the window width. The names, icons, and page contents remain the same.
Open Review → Accounts. Live accounts, replay sessions, and backtest results are grouped by type.
